# 🛡️ Security Policy & Anti-Bot Cloning Declaration

This repository is maintained by **brecha system mexico** (De México para el Mundo). We are committed to fostering open cooperation, software freedom, and technological sovereignty while protecting the integrity of our architectural work.

---

## 🤖 1. Anti-Bot Cloning and Automated Scraping Policy

To protect this repository from automated crawlers, copy-paste bots, and unauthorized training models:

* **Real Traffic Only:** This codebase is intended for human developers, auditors, and open-source contributors. Automated cloning, harvesting, or massive scraping of this repository for the purpose of re-selling, re-hosting under commercial wrappers, or training commercial closed-source AI models without explicit attribution is **strictly prohibited**.
* **Rate Limiting and Monitoring:** We monitor automated cloning traffic and API requests. Repetitive cloning sequences from non-verified bots or cloud scrapers may trigger IP blocking and automated abuse reporting to GitHub Security.

---

## ⚖️ 2. Architectural Integrity and Legal Enforcement

This software is protected under **brecha system mexico** copyright and the custom proprietary terms in [LICENSE.md](file:///c:/Users/codem/Downloads/admin.com/LICENSE.md):

* **The 80% Architecture Rule:** Any derivative project, clone, or commercial implementation that replicates **80% or more of the core operational architecture** (such as the local SQLite standalone engine combined with light cloud authorization, the visual Terra Map module enrooting, or the offline P2P LAN Wi-Fi synchronizer) will be legally pursued as **Intellectual Property Theft**.
* **Jurisdiction:** All legal enforcement regarding unauthorized commercial exploitation or architectural cloning will be processed under the Federal Law for the Protection of Industrial Property (IMPI/INDAUTOR) in Mexico, as well as the WIPO Copyright Treaty and international intellectual property courts.
